test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Seven persons N, O, P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a row facing North. Only three persons are sitting between P and T. N is sitting at one end. P is sitting somewhere to the left of N. O is to the immediate right of P and immediate left of R. Exactly two people are sitting to the right of T who is sitting to the immediate right of Q. Who is sitting in the middle?
solution:
Given: Seven persons N, O, P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a row facing North.

1) Exactly two people are sitting to the right of T who is sitting to the immediate right of Q. 

2) Only three persons are sitting between P and T. 

3) N is sitting at one end. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d90a180c7444eba339fb19d0945ddf9858336f8800c2a0f1ae8ccf3bb9577b6e.png] 

4) P is sitting somewhere to the left of N.

5) O is to the immediate right of P and immediate left of R.

And, S will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3350dd70e125ba5866654dc46078addc111d7cd3cdc81a96074d1befcf6bf1c6.png] 

So, 'Q' is sitting in the middle.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
